statement: A lock tx may carry a route: the entity ids of the hops after its payee, at most MAX_ROUTE_HOPS (16). The Account reads none of it and the proof body has none of it: it is in the frame's name, so both sides signed the same route or none, and a lock with a longer route is refused at the door (route_too_long). The wire reader takes only a list of entity ids of at most that length, and a lock without a route is as it was.
source: testnet-e2e step S5 (gap htlc-route-source); og's HTLC lock envelope (xln-inventory-runs.md 4801-5306); the builder's route-source decision, 10-01
